mintAuthority.summary: GYEN uses GMO Trust's role-based fiat-token contract: a minter mints within capacity, while owner/admin roles can change privileged accounts and parameters.

controls.label: GYEN current minter
controls.capDescription: GMO Trust source describes a capacity limit: minter cannot mint beyond capacity, while a separate capper can adjust capacity.
controls.evidence: minter() (selector 0x4ffed66c) returned this address at Ethereum block 25295183; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). GMO Trust source describes minter as the role that mints tokens within capacity.

controls.evidence: owner() (selector 0x8da5cb5b) returned this address at Ethereum block 25295183; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). GMO Trust source says owner performs admin and minterAdmin assignments.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: minter()=0x78AFae...1C (EOA), owner()=0xfb5dAE...6D (EOA), admin()=0x703736...17 (EOA), minterAdmin()=0x1e412a...e3 (EOA), pauser()=0xe73b76...40 (EOA), prohibiter()=0x72fe98...cf (EOA), wiper()=0x42757e...6e (EOA), capper()=0xb95ab5...0a (EOA), proxy admin slot=0xe5e877...73 (EOA). All role holders are EOAs consistent with GMO Trust institutional key custody. Solana and Stellar deployments not verified (separate minting mechanisms). Solana mint authority resolved at slot 425797741: 2-of-2 SPL token multisig. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled EOAs can raise capacity or mint, NYDFS supervises GMO Trust, and whole-supply reconciliation is unverified across all deployments. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: The Network Firm's monthly reports aggregate Ethereum, Stellar, and Solana supply but omit the separately mintable Arbitrum contract, so whole-supply reconciliation remains unknown.
